title: Pan-Seared Sweet Potato Frites
description: A French-inspired recipe for crispy sweet potato fries, pan-seared to perfection.
instructions: Cut sweet potatoes into long, thin strips.
Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
When oil is hot, add a few sweet potato strips to the skillet and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, remove fries from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining sweet potato strips.
Season fries with salt and black pepper to taste.
